capability.title: Compose Image Prompts — Field & Proof of Work
capability.summary: Bound by local services and industrial. There is no product shot: the proof is the work, the site and the person who did it. Polish actively reduces credibility here.

compose.system_append:
FIELD DISCIPLINE
- Real working environment with its real mess. A spotless site reads as staged and loses the trust the image was meant to buy.
- Correct, complete PPE on every person in frame, appropriate to the environment shown. Never depict an unsafe practice, even in the background.
- Available light, phone-camera plausible. Studio lighting is wrong for this category.
- Before/after pairs share framing, lens and distance so the change is the only variable.
- Show the work, not a portrait of someone near the work.
